feedback.end: The past perfect tense shows that something took place prior to another action in the past.

instruction.text: Select the words that make up the past perfect tense.

atoms.b: I ((had finished)) the assignment by the time my parents came home.

instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the past perfect form of the verb.

trainers.hint:
To form the past perfect tense, you need the helping verb 'had' and the past participle form of a verb.

For example:
She had done this before.
